question: Lokrang, a five-day festival organised by the Madhya Pradesh Adivasi Lok Kala Academy, begins on ______________ every year.
solution:
The correct answer is __**26th January**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Lokrang** is a five-day cultural festival organized annually by the Madhya Pradesh Adivasi Lok Kala Academy.
 
• The festival begins every year on **26th January**, coinciding with India's Republic Day celebrations.
 
• **Lokrang** aims to showcase and celebrate the rich tribal and folk culture of Madhya Pradesh and other regions of India.
 
• The festival includes performances of folk music, dance, art exhibitions, and workshops featuring various tribal communities.
 
• **International artists** and participants also join the festival, adding a global touch to the cultural exchange.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Madhya Pradesh Adivasi Lok Kala Academy**

 
 
• The academy is dedicated to preserving and promoting the tribal and folk art forms of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• It organizes events like Lokrang and other exhibitions to encourage cultural exchange and awareness.
 
 
 
• **Folk and Tribal Arts**
 
 
• India is home to diverse folk and tribal art forms, including music, dance, and painting.
 
• These art forms are often deeply rooted in local traditions, rituals, and community practices.
 
 
 
• **Significance of 26th January**
 
 
• 26th January marks Republic Day in India, commemorating the adoption of the Constitution in 1950.
 
• It is celebrated nationwide with parades, cultural programs, and patriotic events.
 
 
 
• **Global Cultural Exchange**
 
 
• Events like Lokrang provide a platform for international artists to interact with Indian tribal and folk communities.
 
• Such exchanges help in fostering cross-cultural understanding and appreciation.
